learning_outcomes.text: Acquire basic knowledge for the calculation, operation, and maintenance of lifting and transport machines, as a foundation for future mechanical engineers.
Understand the constructive aspects and strength calculation of component parts of lifting and transport machines, and the conditions imposed by ISCIR legislation for their technical state.

syllabus_topics: Lifting machines - generalities: Classification; Structural composition; Main parameters; Introduction to the strength calculation of lifting machines
Cranes and overhead traveling cranes: Composition; Mechanisms; Safety devices
Specific component elements of lifting machines: Flexible elements for lifting and traction; Elements for guiding and actuating the flexible element; Suspension and gripping elements
Elevators: Composition; elevator cable calculation
Mechanized and automated conveyors: Conveyors with flexible traction element; Conveyors without flexible traction element
Simple lifting mechanisms; Winches; Hoists; Capstans
Safety and protection norms (ISCIR norms), quality
Occupational safety and health (OSH) and PSI norms + Lab presentation; "Study of the simple hoist"
Study of steel cables
"Tensile testing of cables by breaking the cable strand by strand"
"Deformation and breaking test of round steel chains"
"Determination of stresses in the dangerous section of a crane hook"
Analytical determination of belt conveyor parameters
Re-doing practical works and concluding activity
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Hoist calculation
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Hook calculation, selection and verification
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Cable calculation, selection and verification
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Hook equipment calculation
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Electric motor calculation, selection and verification
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Reducer calculation, selection and verification
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Drum calculation, selection, verification and assembly
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Brake calculation, selection and verification
Design of the hook equipment and the lifting mechanism for an overhead crane trolley: Assembly drawing of the lifting mechanism
assessment_rules: To pass the exam, an average grade of 5 must be obtained for both theory and practical activities. It is mandatory to obtain a grade of 5 for at least 2 subjects on the written exam. A grade of 5 for applied activities is also mandatory. Passing any part is recognized until the end of the respective academic year.
